Her figure is divided into 3 vertical bands by 2 hazy transition zones centred about 43% of the way across her figure from her left edge and about 77% of the way across her figure from her left edge. Each transition zone is about a hand's width wide, and across it the neighbouring materials dissolve into each other, elements from one thinning out as elements from the other appear, density fading rather than stopping abruptly, never a hard edge. Each transition zone follows a smooth, even, straight course. Even inside a transition zone the skin is never left bare: at every point one material, or a mixture of the two, fully covers it., no fabric no seam no garment anywhere, every material fused to or erupting from her own living skin, covering her completely with no bare skin anywhere from neck to ankle. Pose: three-quarter angle, one hand on the outer hip, the other raised overhead, every region clearly visible to the camera — most extreme powerlifter bombshell silhouette ever displayed.
